claims: The Fab Five refers to the 1991 University of Michigan men's basketball recruiting class consisting of Chris Webber, Jalen Rose, Juwan Howard, Jimmy King, and Ray Jackson.
The Fab Five was the first NCAA team to start five freshmen in a championship game in 1992 and 1993.
Chris Webber (#4), Jalen Rose (#5), Juwan Howard (#25), Jimmy King (#24), Ray Jackson (#21).
